 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Borussia Dortmund are looking to build on their two wins and one defeat in the Champions League league phase tonight, ideally taking all three points against Real Betis.
 The game has yet to produce any goals, but there was bad news for the hosts just over ten minutes before half-time.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Serhou Guirassy went down near the opposition penalty area, clutching his thigh. He tried to carry on, but the striker ultimately had to be substituted before the break. Konstantinos Karetsas replaced him in the 34th minute.
 That is, of course, a real blow. With four goals in four games, Guirassy is Dortmund's leading scorer in this season's Champions League.
 The Black and Yellows will now have to find a way past Real Betis without him.
 What do you think – will BVB take the lead soon?
